snippet.title: PIGFACE | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
PIGFACE is a kinetic, fast-paced, ultra-violent first-person shooter. You play as Exit, a terrible woman whose awful actions have forced her to be a contract killer for people even worse than her. Go in guns-blazing, or take it slow and tactical, whatever it takes to Get The Job Done.

Coming Soon from titolovesyou and DreadXP. Wishlist Now!
